:::{#def-class-np}
#### The class NP

A [decision problem](#def-decision-problem) $L$ is in **NP**
if there are a polynomial $q$ and an algorithm $V$, the *verifier*,
which takes two binary strings $x$ and $u$ as input
and runs in time polynomial in $|x|$,
such that for every $x \in \{0, 1\}^*$,

$$
x \in L
\quad \text{if and only if} \quad
V(x, u) = 1 \text{ for some } u \in \{0, 1\}^{q(|x|)}.
$$

A string $u$ with $V(x, u) = 1$ is a *certificate* for $x$
[@arora2009computational, section 2.1].

:::
